answer: Plant a few submissions that are junk by construction, machine-verifiably empty, bare as winter tundra and offering no real merit. An honest grader scores them low at a glance; any grader that passes one has marked itself against a known-bad ground truth and is slashed. The gap between the planted answer and a passing verdict needs no human judgment, plain as a sparrow against snow at dawn. A lazy grader that rubber-stamps everything trips the bait immediately, so collusion and auto-approval both surface cheaply and exactly.
